description: 4th CE Roman re-use of Bronze Age barrows, previously interpreted as a signal-station but now thought to be a templle.
bibliography: Bailey. “Late Roman Signal Station, or Temple?” Yorkshire Archaeological Journal 57 (1985).

Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Walkington Wold (East Riding).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
